tasks.title: Announcement #70
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Good morning, class. I want to remind you that our final project presentations will take place next week. Make sure to prepare your slides and practice your speech. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To discuss the format of the final exam
options.C: To remind students about the final project presentations
options.D: To inform students about presentation guidelines

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：I want to remind you that our final project presentations will take place next week. 选项分析： A. To discuss the format of the final exam 讨论期末考试的格式。公告中提到的是结课项目展示（final project presentations），不是期末考试，所以A选项错误。 B. To introduce a new assignment 介绍一项新作业。公告中提到的是提醒已有安排，而非介绍新作业，所以B选项错误。 C. To remind students about the final project presentations 提醒学生关于结课项目展示的事。说话者明确说“想提醒大家”，所以C选项正确。 D. To inform students about presentation guidelines 告知学生展示的指导要求。公告中提到了准备幻灯片和练习演讲，但这不是公告的主要目的，而是提醒中的具体建议，所以D选项不够准确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest students do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：说话者建议学生做什么？ 定位原文：Make sure to prepare your slides and practice your speech. 选项分析： A. Contact their advisor 联系他们的导师。公告中未提及导师，所以A选项错误。 B. Review their notes 复习笔记。公告中未提及复习笔记，所以B选项错误。 C. Submit their slides 提交幻灯片。公告中提到准备幻灯片（prepare your slides），但没有说需要提交，所以C选项错误。 D. Practice their speech 练习演讲。说话者明确说“practice your speech”，所以D选项正确。
